description: Perception-completeness probes — elements behind a boundary the default document.querySelectorAll won't cross. /shadow-dom hosts buttons + a link inside a Web Component's OPEN shadow root. F1 makes query_all pierce shadow roots so the agent can perceive + act on them; the link scenario is hard-verified by must_reach_url (clicking the shadow link navigates to /healthy-page).

scenarios.goal: Log in, go to the shadow DOM page at /shadow-dom, and click the first button inside the shadow component on that page.
Log in, go to the shadow DOM page at /shadow-dom, and click the 'Shadow Link' link that lives inside the shadow component.
